variable_coverage.construction: PRICE: Price per share three months after the end of fiscal year t; measured in dollars per share. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

BVE: Book value of equity at the end of year t divided by the number of shares outstanding; measured in dollars per share. Reported formula: BVE_it = book value of equity at end of year t / shares outstanding.. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

PVINCOME: Present value of expected future abnormal earnings for years t+1 through t+3. Expected EPS1, EPS2, and EPS3 are proxied by mean analyst forecasts AF1_post, AF2_post, and AF3_post issued after the year-t earnings announcement. AF3_post is the mean long-term earnings-growth forecast multiplied by AF2_post, as stated. Expected book value rolls forward as BVE1 = BVE + expected EPS1 - expected dividends1 and BVE2 = BVE1 + expected EPS2 - expected dividends2. Expected dividends in years 1 and 2 equal expected EPS times PAYOUT. PAYOUT is the prior-three-year average dividends-to-net-income ratio; if a year has negative net income, that year’s net income is set to 6% of total assets for this calculation. Cost of equity r is max(Rf + beta*(Rm-Rf), Rf); Rf is the year-end 10-year Treasury Note rate and Rm-Rf is fixed at 7.6%. Beta is the estimated coefficient on the CRSP value-weighted index including dividends from a market-model regression using daily returns over the 250 trading days before the year-t earnings announcement. Reported formula: PVINCOME_it = [E_t(EPS1_it) - r_it*E_t(BVE_it)]/(1+r_it) + [E_t(EPS2_it) - r_it*E_t(BVE1_it)]/(1+r_it)^2 + [E_t(EPS3_it) - r_it*E_t(BVE2_it)]/[(1+r_it)^2*r_it]; E_t(BVE1_it)=BVE_it+E_t(EPS1_it)-E_t(DIV1_it); E_t(BVE2_it)=E_t(BVE1_it)+E_t(EPS2_it)-E_t(DIV2_it); E_t(DIVj_it)=E_t(EPSj_it)*PAYOUT_it (j=1,2); r_it=max(Rf_t+beta_it*(Rm-Rf),Rf_t), Rm-Rf=7.6%.. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

MEET1: Indicator equal to one when the current-year earnings surprise is at least −$0.005 per share (one-half cent), and zero otherwise. Earnings surprise is realized EPS minus the mean analyst forecast of year-t EPS issued shortly before the year-t earnings announcement. Reported formula: MEET1=1 if the required current/prior-year earnings surprise(s) are each >= -0.005 dollars per share; 0 otherwise.. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

ACTPVINC: Ex post measure of PVINCOME, computed by substituting realized EPS for expected EPS in years t+1, t+2, and t+3; measured in dollars per share. Reported formula: ACTPVINC is calculated by applying the PVINCOME abnormal-earnings present-value formula using realized EPS1, EPS2, and EPS3 in place of expected EPS1, EPS2, and EPS3.. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

design_coverage.reason: Retain the paper’s MEET1/MEET2/MEET3 sample windows and require the specified annual Compustat data, I/B/E/S forecasts and CRSP observations; MEET2/3 start later because they require prior-year surprises, and sample end allows three future earnings years.
Join Compustat GVKEY, CRSP PERMNO and I/B/E/S ticker/CUSIP using effective-dated CCM and IBES–CRSP link rows.
No fixed-effect dummy groups are reported for the selected simultaneous Mishkin fits.
The selected model inventory does not report a cluster correction; no cluster is inferred.
No regression weights are reported.
The authors jointly estimate the forecasting and pricing equations using the Mishkin methodology; the exact likelihood/estimator and error specification remain unreported.
Apply the MEET1, MEET2 and MEET3 cumulative current/prior-year surprise rules; retain the post-announcement forecast construction and three-year realized-earnings horizon.

implementation_issues.description: The Mishkin system’s exact estimator, error distribution/covariance assumptions, and optimizer are not named; “Mishkin methodology” does not identify the full likelihood implementation.
The forecast statistic selection around current and prior earnings announcements is described as shortly before/after but lacks an exact I/B/E/S date cutoff and vintage tie-break rule.
The beta regression uses 250 trading days before each announcement, but the paper does not give the exact return transformation, intercept treatment or error procedure.
PAYOUT’s year-end denominator handling and the exact fiscal-year/announcement-date alignment must be encoded from the source; preserve the 6%-of-assets rule for negative net income.
The sample describes a 1996 Compustat merged annual vintage; current Compustat and I/B/E/S summary history may differ. The original sample period and event rules are retained.

review_notes: The frozen Table 5 model pairs are retained for each MEET1/2/3 design. The support beta model remains mandatory for PVINCOME.
The observed future EPS inputs extend through t+3, while forecast origins stop at the assigned MEET-specific years; do not shift the estimation origin to the future outcome date.
